ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  AIRAN Limited's board meeting disclosed significant governance changes, including the simultaneous resignation of two independent directors and the appointment of two new board members. A material red flag is the re-appointment of the incumbent auditor, M/S. Supal Shah & Associates, for a fresh five-year term, effectively replacing themselves, which raises concerns about auditor independence and adherence to best practices for audit firm rotation. These board and audit committee changes warrant careful scrutiny by shareholders.
